answer: Proposal 'syncgate': entry requires presence at a live simultaneous event. Each epoch a beacon sorts entrants at random into small live groups; members vouch each attendee is a distinct live person, the ledger admitting one identity per witnessed body. No one sits in two groups at once, so a swarm cheap as willow cuttings still needs one paid human per alias per event. Cost is linear, so the gate holds only while per-identity reward stays below that wage. Assumption: witnesses mostly honest; deepfake video tests this ferrous hinge, and a sable rental market in bodies is the open flank.
